view_meta: the ASA-style policy engine — autonomy mode & honest posture, rules-as-data (LIVE editor), the graduation ladder, and the decision log (authZ metadata only, no secrets · TG-94).
purpose: POLICY surface (record domain, epic TG-94/TG-106): the operator window onto the ASA-style Policy Engine, rendered LIVE from the read-only /v1/policy/{mode,rules,graduation,decisions} read surface (spec/015 T-015-12) plus the POST /v1/policy/trace packet-tracer (TG-105). Five honest sections — (1) mode & posture: a prominent card color-coded by the active autonomy mode (Shadow/HITL=read-only safe, Semi-auto/Full-auto=warn) rendering the API's own honest booleans (may_auto_actuate / requires_human_vote / persisted) and the worker's live mutation-gate posture; the mode-change control is the LIVE gated admin write (TG-106) — an admin-elevated, ledgered, compare-and-swap autonomy-mode transition (POST /api/v1/mode {to, expected_from, reason}), double-confirmed in RED for the allow-all Full-auto posture and executed by the worker's chokepoint-bound ModeController (the console never flips the mode itself; spec/015 REQ-1502); (2) ASA rules: the active rules-as-data as an ordered, top-down, deny-overrides access-list — per-rule verdict badge (allow/approve/deny), selector (host/glob/group/device-class), op-class, params (band_mode, min_confidence, rate_limit), approve_by, reversibility, and the fail-closed default row; editing is the LIVE gated admin write (TG-104 slice-2) — an admin-elevated, ledgered, compare-and-swap FULL-ruleset replacement (POST /v1/policy/ruleset {document, expected_version, rationale}) driven by an inline per-rule-card editor (id, verdict, selector kind+pattern, op-class, argv-pattern, territory, reversible, min-confidence, band-mode, rate-limit, approve-by, is-default, plus add/delete/move-up/move-down in deny-overrides order) that round-trips every field faithfully (the read renders selector kinds HYPHENATED and params flattened; the editor maps each kind back to the write schema's UNDERSCORE match key and re-nests params under `params`, dropping nothing — a dropped dimension or default is how a deny silently becomes an allow), pins the read's version as the compare-and-swap guard, and FAILS CLOSED on a ruleset carrying a top-level default the read can't project (has_default → the editor refuses to open/save); (3) graduation ladder: per-op-class level (approve|auto) + clean-run progress toward promotion (against the engine's default threshold, honestly labeled) + last-outcome chip — the earned-autonomy view; (4) decision log: the recent policy_decision audit table (rule_id, verdict, composed band, min-confidence, mode, time) with a ?limit= selector honored; (5) packet-tracer ('may TG act on host X with op-class Y?', TG-105): a LIVE, READ-ONLY form (op_class + host required, optional resource, confidence 0..1 default 0.7, band AUTO/AUTO_NOTICE/POLL_PAUSE, mode Shadow/HITL/Semi-auto/Full-auto DEFAULTED to the live liveState.policyMode so an omitted mode answers 'what would happen right now', falling back to a labeled Shadow only when the live mode is unknown) that POSTs a hypothetical candidate to /api/v1/policy/trace and renders the worker's REAL composed verdict — a chip-ok/chip-warn/chip-bad badge (auto=permitted / approve=human-gated / deny=blocked), the composed band, the matched rule id (or an honest fail-closed 'default — no rule matched'), the full deny-overrides matched_rules table, approve_by on an approve, the never-auto floor, the bundle version, and the multi-clause reason — with a MANDATORY caveat that the trace does NOT simulate the runtime rate governor (rate_governor_simulated is always false), so a composed auto may still be rate-clamped to approve at real actuation. Real states only (idle/loading/result/honest error: 401 re-gates to the auth overlay, 400 shows the validation message, 503/network say the engine was unreachable) — never a fabricated verdict, and it actuates nothing and writes no policy_decision row.
notes: Honesty contract: NO fixture — every value is fetched live at session adoption. Unauthenticated shows only the auth gate; authenticated, an unavailable endpoint (503 fail-closed) renders an honest error state and an empty spine an honest empty state, never a fabricated row (INV-15). Sealed values never appear (INV-13): the payload carries only non-secret authZ metadata (modes, verdicts, bands, op-classes, selectors, counts) and the surface has no control that requests or displays key material, argv, or host credential. The mode-change control is the live gated admin write (TG-106): it requires an admin-ELEVATED session (the SAME shared step-up modal + /api/v1/session/elevate that config/secret writes use — a 401 drives the step-up, not a new flow), is compare-and-swap on expected_from (a 409 shows an honest 'the mode changed underneath you — re-read and retry', never a silent overwrite), and is double-confirmed in RED for the allow-all Full-auto posture (WARN, never BLOCK — the operator may proceed after confirming). It has real states only (idle showing the live mode / select / plain-or-RED confirm / submitting / the honest committed ModeTransitionOutcome / an honest refusal on 401·403·409·503·network) and NEVER fabricates a mode or a success (INV-15); it sends only {to, expected_from, reason} plus the same-origin elevated cookie (no secret, no bypass of the backend chokepoint). The rule-edit control is now the LIVE gated admin write too (TG-104 slice-2): the same shared admin step-up (a 401 drives it), compare-and-swap on the read's version (a 409 shows an honest 'the ruleset changed underneath you — re-read, never overwrite'), validated by the worker (a 400 shows the validator's VERBATIM message with no success claim), real states only (editing / saving / the honest committed outcome / an honest refusal), and FAIL-CLOSED by construction — it never emits a top-level default and refuses to edit/save a ruleset that has one it can't represent (has_default), and its read→write mapping drops no field (the safety property: a round-trip must never turn a deny into an implicit allow). It sends only {document, expected_version, rationale} plus the same-origin elevated cookie — no secret, no bypass of the worker's ParseRuleSet authority or admin gate. The packet-tracer is LIVE but READ-ONLY: it POSTs a hypothetical to /api/v1/policy/trace and renders the engine's real composed verdict across four real states (idle/loading/result/honest error) — never a fabricated or simulated verdict (INV-15), it actuates nothing and writes no decision row, and the response is authZ metadata only (no argv/host credential, INV-13). Its rate-governor honesty note is mandatory and never hidden: rate_governor_simulated is always false, so the surface states plainly that a composed auto may still be rate-clamped to approve at real actuation. Reuses the console design system verbatim: chip-ok/chip-warn/chip-bad outcome semantics, the map-vs-territory plane language (map=indigo for the AI/auto, territory=steel for observed ground truth), wrapcard/tbl/sec/empty components, and the same theme tokens — no new palette. Tables live in their own overflow-x:auto container so the page body never scrolls sideways. Live state (liveState.policyMode/policyRules/policyGraduation/policyDecisions) is populated by modules/_live/js.txt liveAdopt(); the decision-log limit selector re-fetches and re-renders in place.
verified: assemble.py rebuild byte-clean; node --check on the extracted bundle passes; hash-route #policy registers and all five sections render, including the LIVE packet-tracer: e2e/policy-tracer.mjs stubs POST /api/v1/policy/trace and asserts the idle state, the mode select defaulting to the live liveState.policyMode, the composed-verdict chip + reason + matched-rule + the mandatory rate-governor caveat on a 200, and an honest error state (never a verdict) on a 503 — exercised against a stubbed API via Playwright. The LIVE mode-change write (TG-106) is covered by e2e/mode-selector.mjs, which stubs POST /api/v1/mode + /api/v1/session/elevate and asserts: the live current mode renders and enables the control; picking Full-auto raises the RED double-warn and cancelling it POSTs nothing; a normal transition uses the plain confirm; a confirmed transition drives the shared elevation step-up on a 401 and then POSTs {to, expected_from, reason} and renders the honest committed outcome; a 409 shows the honest 'changed underneath you' state with no fabricated success; and a 503 shows an honest error. The LIVE rules-as-data editor (TG-104 slice-2) is covered by e2e/rule-editor.mjs, which stubs POST /api/v1/policy/ruleset + /api/v1/session/elevate and asserts: the ★ identity round-trip (loading the SHIPPED core/policy/default_ruleset.json, opening the editor, Saving unedited, and asserting the posted document is SEMANTICALLY EQUAL to the original — proving no field, including min_confidence:0, is dropped); a selector-kind + every-field round-trip (every hyphenated read kind maps back to its underscore write key, params re-nest under `params`); an edit that changes ONLY the edited field with the version pinned; add/delete/move reflected in the posted order; a 400 showing the backend's VERBATIM validator text with no success; a 409 'changed underneath you' whose Re-read REFETCHES and resets the CAS baseline with no silent overwrite; a 401 driving the shared step-up then completing; and has_default=true failing closed (no cards, no Save, no POST).
